original_test_intent: Measure M.2 sequential read bandwidth and IOPS using the approved Windows CrystalDiskMark profile and compare the displayed result with the project specification.
original_method: Qualified operator records Windows, M.2 and CrystalDiskMark identity, selects sequential-read-only GUI profile, runs it once, saves full screenshot/export and health/events. Any Linux fio proxy is a changed method needing explicit equivalence, secure access and separate acceptance.
manual_activity: Qualified operator runs the approved Windows GUI sequential-read profile and captures result; user may separately approve a secure comparable fio plan.
required_inputs: Approved Windows SUT and CrystalDiskMark version/checksum
Sequential-read profile, size/count/cache/power settings and duration
Versioned read MB/s/IOPS thresholds and tolerance
Health/thermal abort and evidence policy; if proxy proposed, formal equivalence and secure execution plan
safety_requirements: Verify target and read-only GUI item; disable unapproved writes
Never copy sshpass inline credentials or StrictHostKeyChecking=no
Do not run fio proxy without explicit method-equivalence approval and target mapping
Stop on wrong target, unexpected writes, device/thermal error or unclear comparability
No automatic method switch or retry
agent_execution_scope: Review operator GUI evidence and compare metrics with supplied spec
If alternate approved, review its equivalence decision, secure settings and complete logs
Do not drive GUI, use unsafe SSH, silently substitute fio or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Approve or reject any alternate fio method with comparability baseline

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not valid as an automatic substitute: fio bs1M/iodepth32/runtime30/libaio may not match CrystalDiskMark, while sshpass and host-key bypass are prohibited.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: MANUAL ONLY for original source: run approved CrystalDiskMark sequential-read GUI profile. Treat any secure fio execution as separately approved changed method.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: M.2 sequential read, bandwidth/IOPS, Windows GUI and20/30 planning fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Prefer signed operator GUI evidence; if proxy is accepted, bind exact fio/device/profile and reference mapping in a separate plan.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds target/profile identity, rejects unsafe access and separates alternate method from original coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: fio results do not satisfy CrystalDiskMark coverage unless engineering explicitly accepts equivalence.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: OS I/O stack, block size, queue depth, caching and tool reporting differ between CrystalDiskMark and fio.

project_override_considerations: An explicit project decision may accept fio as an alternate, but it must state equivalence and cannot be reported as original GUI execution.
expected_evidence: Sequential-read GUI profile and unmodified screenshot/export
Read MB/s and IOPS mapped to thresholds
If proxy: approval, secure command/settings, device map, full logs and comparability decision

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently names CrystalDiskMark sequential read and spec comparison. The inconsistency lies in DeepSeek's alternate review, not in protected source; missing settings are readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: A Windows operator can perform the source method when inputs are supplied; an alternate proxy is optional and does not make the row inherently blocked.

review_improvement: Rejects unsafe/unproven proxy substitution while preserving both original GUI coverage and a controlled path for separately approved equivalence.
independent_technical_reasoning: A fio sequential read with 1MiB blocks and queue depth32 does not automatically reproduce CrystalDiskMark's selected row, thread/queue, test-file and cache behavior. Tool/OS stacks also report IOPS differently. Therefore operator GUI evidence remains authoritative unless engineering approves a metric-by-metric mapping; insecure SSH cannot be part of either path.
